name: [UPDATE] MM2 of The Monsters
desc:
🩸 ONE MONSTER. EVERYONE ELSE MUST SURVIVE.

👹 Each round, one player becomes the Monster. Everyone else must hide, escape, and survive the hunt.

🔦 Use Flashlights, Tasers, Cameras, and Bear Traps.
⚡ Activate Adrenaline Shot or Invisibility to survive.
💰 Earn coins every round.
🛒 Unlock new monsters, items, and abilities.
❤️ Buy extra lives and get back into the action.
🗺️ Vote for the next map!

Can you survive the Monster?

🎮 Play on PC, Console, Mobile, and Tablet.

llm.loop: each round one player becomes the monster -> others hide/escape with gadgets -> survivors earn coins -> unlock monsters, items, abilities
llm.objectives: survive the monster's hunt, or kill everyone as the monster
llm.instructions: one player is the monster, everyone else hides, escapes and survives; use flashlights, tasers, traps; vote for maps
unique: Murder-Mystery-style 1v-all round format reskinned with creepypasta monsters (Siren Head etc.)
llm.thumbnails: crowd of scared Roblox avatars in a lobby with giant monsters (Siren Head) looming; flashlight in dark corridor
llm.complexity_notes: round-based lobby + several maps, monster models, simple gadget tools
